tasks.short: Interpret assembly drawings and plan operations

steps.what: Read and interpret assembly blueprints or specifications manuals for the actual machine variant
Plan assembly or building operations from interpreted requirements and clarify unresolved engineering constraints

tasks.design: Retain technical drawing interpretation and operation planning with the assembler, using controlled originals in {DOCS}. Native job-to-document links can aid access, but the task establishes no independent browsing or report-production share to remove.
tasks.previous_blocker: A drawing must be interpreted against the actual variant and assembly conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital instruction products and manual question tools exist, but their capabilities do not establish replacement of this assembler's interpretation and planning.
tasks.still_hard: Drawing ambiguities, access constraints and variant differences require technical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when a plausible assembly sequence conflicts with the drawing or real conditions.
tasks.altitude: Protect interpretation and planning time rather than treating a retrieved instruction as a complete plan.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of production and operating workers
reach.task: Clarify a variant-specific assembly planning constraint
reach.learn: How production conditions affect an interpreted assembly sequence

evidence.claim: Azumuta supports variant-specific instructions from jobs, but that does not establish automatic interpretation of arbitrary assembly blueprints.
The Siemens operations assistant provides manual-based error explanations in the digest; no measured savings for blueprint interpretation or assembly planning are supplied.
Retaining the full interpretation and planning baseline is an E1 design choice pending direct observation.

assumptions: Boundary is reading, interpreting and planning, excluding drawing creation, bill-of-materials maintenance, physical assembly and production reporting. This is not an assembly procedure.

Engineering supplies controlled drawings, specifications and known changes before s1; the job owner supplies machine/variant context. The assembler verifies applicability and interprets dimensions and constraints within s1's retained 60 hours. Responsible engineering personnel answer unresolved questions during s2 before the plan is treated as resolved; assembler clarification remains in its 40 hours. No free correct-variant, complete-materials or assembly-feasible flag is assumed.

Use existing controlled originals and native job links first. Unresolved drawings return for engineering clarification; no generative diagram interpretation, new capture duty or additional tool upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual variant control and separate document-search workload
Delegated authority for assembly planning changes
research_questions: Which time belongs to necessary interpretation and planning, and is any separately measurable time spent finding controlled originals?

already_counted.description: Contextual operation planning and engineering clarification

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Interpretation and planning remain human work; product admin and rework case figures are not transferred to this task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain ownership of drawing meaning and assembly planning while using controlled existing references.
reach: Clarify variant and workplace constraints with production supervisors
role.ambitious_version: An assembler with reliable controlled references and time protected for technical interpretation.
